analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 31.4 to 42.7, attempting to exit oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -6.6609 to -0.1231, signaling bottoming action. A Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at $662.02 above the 20-day low at $647.05. However, trading volume at 0.70 of the 5-day average is subdued, reducing confidence in directional confirmation. Weekly ADX at 15.5 indicates weak trend strength. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
